name: jhipster-clock-authorities
description: Replication on an open-source Spring Boot app: a design-shaping rule (Clock injection) and a mechanical rule (authorities from constants), as linked prose, always-loaded prose, or rules + pointer + feedback loop.

tasks.prompt: Add an admin-only REST endpoint GET /api/admin/users/recently-created that returns the logins of users created in the last 7 days. Put the query in the user repository and the logic in the user service. Do not run the build.
Add an admin-only REST endpoint GET /api/operations/recent that returns the operations whose date lies within the last 30 days. Do not run the build.

fix.prompt: Code review feedback on your uncommitted change: the new code breaks two project rules. Time must come from an injected java.time.Clock (call Instant.now(clock), never Instant.now() or another now() without a clock), and authority names must come from AuthoritiesConstants, never string literals like "ROLE_ADMIN". Fix the new code accordingly. Do not run the build.
